en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4044 - Safwan narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) about a man who owes me money and repays me partially with dinars and partially with dirhams. When he comes to settle the remaining amount, the price of the dinars has changed.
I asked: "Which price should I calculate, the price on the day he gave me the dinars or the price on the day we settle the account?"
Imam (as) said: "The price on the day he gave you the dinars, because you withheld their benefit from him."
